name: Trap Metal
description: Hybrid trap/metal arc — a rolling hi-hat verse over a droning 808, pivoting hard into a half-time down-tuned breakdown at the metal-tempo equivalent.

defaults.concept: Trap metal — a droning, pitch-glided 808 sub-bass functioning as both percussion and harmonic anchor under rapid triplet hi-hat rolls and a rapped verse, then a hard pivot to a half-time down-tuned guitar breakdown with palm-muted chugs and screamed vocals. Dark, Phrygian, distorted, internet-native aggression.

slots.label: 808 Dread
slots.purpose: FEEL: Dread, anticipation. TRICK: 808 alone with a heavy pitch-glide, plus a distant detuned guitar harmonic or metallic scrape — signal both genres are coming before either fully commits.
slots.groove: 808 sub drone with pitch glides, distant metallic clangs, no drums yet.

slots.label: The Rolling Hats
slots.purpose: FEEL: Menacing, hypnotic, internet-native aggression. PRODUCTION NOTE: Keep the rap vocal dry and forward in the mix; let the hi-hat rolls carry the rhythmic complexity so the flow itself can stay simple and hard-hitting.
slots.groove: Triplet/32nd-note trap hi-hat rolls over a sparse 808-driven kick pattern; snare lands on beat 3 (half-time placement) under the verse.

slots.label: Screamed Hook
slots.purpose: FEEL: Screamed catharsis. TRICK: Stack a clean rapped ad-lib underneath a distorted screamed hook — the contrast between the two vocal textures is the hook's whole appeal.
slots.groove: Hats push to double-time (snare now on 2 and 4), 808 hits harder and more distorted, screamed ad-libs stack over the rapped hook.

slots.label: The Half-Time Pivot
slots.purpose: FEEL: Crushing, physical, mosh-ready. TRICK: This is the half-time pivot — the track's felt pulse effectively halves to the metal-tempo equivalent (roughly 72 BPM); down-tuned guitars enter in full for the first time here, not before.
slots.groove: Hard pivot to half-time — down-tuned, palm-muted power-chord chugs lock with a double-kick pattern; hi-hat rolls drop out entirely.

slots.label: Hard Cut
slots.purpose: FEEL: Abrupt, unresolved. TRICK: No fade — cut everything on the breakdown's final hit, leaving a half-second of dead air before silence.
slots.groove: Distortion and noise wash swallow the last chord; cuts hard, no fade.
